name: The Hollow Crown
notes: Hand-made expedition map (tools/make_hollowcrown.py; the format is described there; the design is docs/MAP_V2.md). A broken continent round the Hollow: wide joined land in the west, broken high ground in the east, Stormbreak's shards in the void between, the walled Crown on its north rim; each region a different fight. Nothing is placed by dice except what the match rolls: which spawn points, lairs and camps are live, loot, the Blight, weather.

regions.name: The Crown
regions.purpose: The vault on the Throne, the Stormcrown Eyrie and the richest chests, behind walls and gates, under the most Blight.

regions.name: Frostgate
regions.purpose: The best armor on the map and the long shelf to shoot from; uplink A in the Rimefield below it.

regions.name: Cinder Steps
regions.purpose: Forge country: gloves and weapon tunings up the cliff tiers, the Sunken Forge and uplink B at the foot.

regions.name: Stormbreak
regions.purpose: The shrine on the Shrine Table, in the middle of the Hollow: every way across is a bridge.

regions.name: Thornwood
regions.purpose: The Boki nest and the Thornhive lair; ambushes in the trees and tall grass.

regions.name: Larkhollow
regions.purpose: Wild Boki graze on the open plain; the most landings, the widest flanks.

regions.name: Highwatch
regions.purpose: Boots, and the towers: the Lantern is the highest ground on the map.

regions.name: Duskmoor
regions.purpose: Relics in the Moor Chapel and its ruin maze: the closest fights on the map.

regions.name: Saltmere
regions.purpose: Salt caches round the lagoon and on its islet; fights on the rim and the one causeway.
